name: HANTRU1 Kwajalein / Ebeye cable landing station
developer: US Army (Reagan Test Site cable station) and Marshall Islands National Telecommunications Authority (Ebeye extension)
notes: Telecom/cable-landing infrastructure, not a commercial colocation datacenter. HANTRU-1 (in service 2010, US Army funded) links the Reagan Test Site on Kwajalein to Guam; 2010 extension includes a Kwajalein/Ebeye landing per TeleGeography landing list (see submarinecablemap.com/submarine-cable/hantru1-cable-system) and FCC DA-09-1309A1. Kwajalein island itself hosts restricted US Army range IT (context only, not enumerable); Ebeye civilian NTA telecom office/landing site confirmed. Re-verified in this pass.

name: IOKWE subsea cable Ebeye landing station
developer: Marshall Islands National Telecommunications Authority (owner/operator) via Google Pacific Connect / Halaihai
notes: Planned cable branch infrastructure, not an operational datacenter. Submarine Networks states IOKWE lands in Majuro and Ebeye (RMI) as a branch to Google's Halaihai cable; NTA is owner/operator; ~2029 RFS reported by trackers (Grade C for exact RFS date).
